about_the_game:
Welcome to Purrfect Stall! A cosy 3D management game where you run your sweet stall and serve fluffy pals! Your only mission is to make PURRfect serves of tanghulu and ice cream before Capymayor takes over it!!

you only got the survey three days to win!!

Game mechanics

Combos

Every successful order you do adds to the current combo. after reaching a certain threshold, you will gain a multiplier or added money corresponding to the money multiplier to the base total. When the coin is automatically collected, it will give an additional bonus to the base total. The combo will break when you screw up an order, but there is a brief window of time you can make use of that multiplier before the multiplier disappears.

prices of food

tanghulu = 5

ice cream = 8

ice cream with toppings =10

tips =2

Upgrade shop

You can buy upgrades to your ingredients to increase the Max uses before a refill is needed. Also, you can also buy crystals. When crystals are used it will restore your full health. On the topic of the crystals to unselect the press mouse 2

Capymayor

When the Capy mayor shows up here, he will take a chunk of your money through taxes. If you don’t have the money or if  your money runs out, you lose the game

Capy mayor will ask for multiple orders and will use some tricks to throw off your game. If you take too long or mess up the order, it will cost you more of your money. After the first day, you must also deal with customers coming in. The crystals don’t work on the mayor.

automatically collected Modes

By default, automatically collected is turned off, but if you want to turn it on.

In the main menu, the settings have a toggle that will turn on automatically collected. When it's on, the money is automatically collected after 25 seconds.

  • Run your Purrfect Stall now!!
